input_references.role: Timestamped raw and matched-road trajectory points

metadata.goal: Analyze how the user's trips are organized across the day and identify variations in daily travel structure.
metadata.category: Daily trip chains, mode allocation, weather, temperature, and route replacement
metadata.header: Daily Chain Mode and Weather Structure
metadata.dataset_description: An independently constructed, road-aligned WorldTrace case containing 168 trajectories.

insight_list.insight: Most active days form multi-trip chains that eventually return near the day's starting area.

plot.title: Daily Chain Mode and Weather Structure: Insight 1
plot.description: Question-specific evidence computed from the synchronized trajectory and point tables; the case-level route overview is retained separately.

insight_list.question: How many active days form multi-trip chains that return near their starting area?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Group trajectories by service date, order their segments, and compare daily start and end positions.

insight_list.insight: Public transport takes the largest share of trips on weekdays, especially for first and last segments of one day's multi-trip chain.

plot.title: Daily Chain Mode and Weather Structure: Insight 2
plot.description: Question-specific evidence computed from the synchronized trajectory and point tables; the case-level route overview is retained separately.

insight_list.question: Which modes account for weekday travel, especially at the first and last chain positions?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compute distance-weighted mode shares for all weekday trips and by chain position.

insight_list.insight: Car trips are always accompanied by rain or hot weather and replace public transport trips on weekdays.

plot.title: Daily Chain Mode and Weather Structure: Insight 3
plot.description: Question-specific evidence computed from the synchronized trajectory and point tables; the case-level route overview is retained separately.

insight_list.question: Under which conditions do car trips occur, and do they occupy usual public-transport route slots?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Track public-transport and car shares on the same route slots across rainfall intensities, and inspect temperature-linked replacement on a fixed route template.

insights: Most active days form multi-trip chains that eventually return near the day's starting area.
Public transport takes the largest share of trips on weekdays, especially for first and last segments of one day's multi-trip chain.
Car trips are always accompanied by rain or hot weather and replace public transport trips on weekdays.
summary: Most active days form multi-trip chains that eventually return near the day's starting area. Public transport takes the largest share of trips on weekdays, especially for first and last segments of one day's multi-trip chain. Car trips are always accompanied by rain or hot weather and replace public transport trips on weekdays.
